title: Foods That Changed the World
main_content:
What foods have helped shape civilization?

The potato is the world’s largest food crop.

Author Christopher Cumo says South Americans introduced the potato to the Spanish in the 16th century. The Spanish loved it and quickly brought it back to Europe.

This next food is the most produced crop in the world. But three-quarters of it go to farm animals.

Cumo says maize is not primarily a food for humans; however, it has long been a cultivated crop for people in the Americas.

Rice may be even more important than corn as a food crop.

Cumo says most humans get the majority of their calories from rice. It is a major part of the diet in China, Southeast Asia and much of India. Rice is also an important food in parts of Africa.

Fish is also essential. Many species of animals eat fish, including humans.

Beans are grown and eaten all over the world. They are members of the legume family. This protein-rich, low-cost crop is related to a number of important food plants.

questions.answer: China, Southeast Asia, and parts of Africa
